'''Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed''' is the seventeenth of the [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|numbered Virtual Sets]] the [[Players Committee]] released between 2002 and 2009. Its 21 cards are printed slips placed over [[Decipher]] cards: some replace only the bottom half (new game text, stats and icons) while the card's title, lore and art stay as printed; others cover the whole card and make it a new card, named on the slip, with the Decipher card it covers named in the slip's caption. Its release date is not recorded in the surviving Committee news; the sheet's official text is dated 6 February 2009.<ref name="legal" /> The Committee's sheet for the set (official text as of 6 February 2009) is the source for the slips shown here.<ref name="ia" /> Icons used on the slips are explained at [[Virtual card icons]].

The second image in each row is a full-card remaster: the printed Decipher card with the slip re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's later Holotable cards, made for the wiki in 2026 (see [[Typography of Star Wars CCG cards]]). These are fan reconstructions, not Committee products. Game text is written out the way the sheet's icon key defines its shorthand.

== History ==
=== Cover pack / set symbol ===

Players Committee printed Virtual set covers with pack mockups and set marks for the later numbered Virtual sheets (same visual family as the Dec 2006 Remaster / Re-edit covers for earlier sets). Cover pack art from the printable sheet. This cover uses a diamond-17 mark on the pack rather than a separate circular cover orb (unlike VS2&ndash;16 Remaster covers). IA Resources/VirtualCards17.pdf CDX empty; CDN legacyblocks used.

=== Provenance ===

Primary cover PDF used for pack and set symbol on this hub:

* CDN day-to-day: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf]
* Wayback Resources/VirtualCards17.pdf: no application/pdf binary recovered (see hunt notes on [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]] / Alpha1 VC Original packs report)

After the 2009 Block reorganization these cards were regrouped into [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Blocks]] / Legacy packaging; framing, errata, and legality can differ.
